items.title: Vercel's Guillermo Rauch urges builders to own their AI stack
items.takeaway: Opinion post: own your harness, data, connections and runtime; embrace open source.
items.soWhat: Lock-in on rented models and agent platforms is becoming a strategic question for leaders.

items.title: DeepSeek open-sources a proactive coding agent that watches your repo
items.takeaway: MIT-licensed research prototype; takes allowed requests and replies with results like a pull request.
items.soWhat: Agents that pick up work on their own are moving from demos to open code teams can inspect.

items.title: Agents built one app in 12 frameworks; costs varied nearly twofold
items.takeaway: Opus 5.5 built the same app five times per framework; median cost ran $2.67 to $4.97.
items.soWhat: Framework choice now shows up in your agent bill, and installed MCPs and skills often went unused.

voices.quote: I have a strong suspicion, for example, that the current crop of MCPs and skills may be doing more harm than good.
Own your harness, data, connections, runtime: your agents. Embrace open source.
